summary: UnifiedRelationVisitor walks the relational AST and compiles to native backend operations. Composes with UnifiedExpressionVisitor for embedded expressions. Handles cross-type join coercion, ConformRelNode apply_conform dispatch, and optional ref_resolver kwarg for DAG named-relation resolution. Uses _core_handlers module for extensible node dispatch.

key_classes.name: UnifiedRelationVisitor
key_classes.purpose: Dispatches visit_* methods per node type, delegates to backend RelationSystem implementations

key_functions.name: visit(node)
key_functions.purpose: Entry point: dispatches to type-specific visit_* methods via _core_handlers

key_functions.name: apply_conform(native, schema)
key_functions.purpose: Compile-time conform: calls _build_conform_exprs with backend column info, dispatches select/with_columns based on fieldsMatch

key_functions.name: compile_expression(expr)
key_functions.purpose: Compiles embedded mountainash expressions to native backend expressions

key_functions.name: _visit_and_coerce_right(right_node, left_result)
key_functions.purpose: Cross-type join: coerces right-side DataFrame to match left-side backend

extension_points: _core_handlers module for registering new node type handlers
lifecycle_notes: 2026-05: apply_conform method bridges conform pipeline to backend-native operations
ref_resolver parameter for DAG support (closes over per-call materialisation cache)
risks: apply_conform creates tight coupling between visitor and conform module
